bugClass: broken access control — IDOR / horizontal privilege escalation (OWASP A01)
oneLineBug: getNote returns the note text by id without verifying requesterId owns it; any user who knows an id reads another user's private note
groundTruthProbe: alice creates note a with 'alice-secret'; getNote('bob', a.id) MUST throw — the buggy impl returns 'alice-secret' to bob
notesForScoringOnly: Tests the SECURITY lens. Catching it requires modeling the access-control policy and attacking with TWO principals (A owns, B requests) — a functional happy-path test (owner reads own note) PASSES on the buggy impl, so a naive verifier that doesn't think adversarially about authorization will MISS it. listNoteIds is correct in both impls (only getNote is broken), so the verifier must specifically probe cross-user getNote.
